exit_criterion: Demonstrated over HTTP by tests/exit_run_phase7.py and recorded in docs/phase-7/exit-run.md. (1) On Tecator under one seeded 10-fold cross-validation, Ridge, Elastic Net, MLR on a VIP-selected set, SVR and OPLS run beside PLS, each added from the Regression group of the step menu; each one's RMSECV matches its reference (scikit-learn on the served folds; OPLS against PLS with equal total components), and each final model exported as JSON and as the Python snippet reproduces application predictions. (2) On the Quadram meat set under grouped, stratified cross-validation, logistic regression and QDA run beside PLS-DA, and OPLS-DA on two of its classes, each matching its reference and exporting as above. (3) A CSV whose class column is coded as numbers shows its classifiers disabled with the reason; the column is made a class through the role control, a new version is derived, and a classifier runs on it.
decisions: 2026-10-30. Phase 7 is modelling breadth. Seven models already ship (PLS, PCR, PLS-DA, LDA, kNN, SVM, SIMCA), but one flat step menu hides them and they vanish without a target or class column; the menu is grouped by type and unavailable models are shown disabled with the reason.

2026-10-30. New models: Ridge, Elastic Net/Lasso, MLR, epsilon-SVR, OPLS and two-class OPLS-DA, multinomial logistic regression, QDA. Each hand-written, with a spec, a parity claim and an export path.

2026-10-30. Deferred: locally weighted PLS (no open reference), Gaussian process regression, random forest and boosting (heavy to hand-write, hard to export, weak at small n), naive Bayes, DD-SIMCA, multi-class OPLS-DA. Genetic-algorithm selection, the plugin API and self-hosted mode stay post-1.0.
2026-10-30. A column's role can be changed after import; the change derives a new dataset version, as sample exclusion does. Included so the disabled-model hint points at a control that exists.
2026-10-30. The tuning curve generalises to any complexity parameter before the penalised models land; PLS and PCR numbers must not move.
2026-10-30. Signed packages (#339) carry over from Phase 6, blocked on certificates, and are not in the exit criterion.

2026-10-30. Unchanged: scikit-learn and chemotools stay development dependencies; SciPy is already a runtime one. One release, v1.3.0, at the end of the phase. Read each feature's issue, not only this list, before calling it done.
